metadata.description: Claude Code plugins shipped with Nustro, the Nushell distro: the nushell skills, and one plugin per module that wants a presence in a session — a client of the shell command the distro provides, so a session gets the same command, care points and guard rails a user has at the prompt.

plugins.name: worktree
plugins.description: The bare-worktree layout from a Claude Code session: /worktree:worktree drives the shell's `worktree` command (init, add, remove, apply, discard, which), a hook denies raw `git worktree add/remove/move` inside a layout, and every session that starts in one is told where it is.

plugins.name: nushell
plugins.description: Two skills and the Nushell language server, no hooks. nushell: writing, debugging and configuring Nushell 0.116 — language, structured data, modules, plugins, completions, $env.config, hooks, keybindings, stdlib, the built-in MCP server — and Nustro, the distro, when it is the shell. nustro-completion-build: teach Tab a CLI, a completions/<tool>.nu for Nustro's engine, the one `agent completion` runs. `nu --lsp` for .nu files: diagnostics after each edit, definitions, references, hover.
